name: codex-kit
description: Plugin-distributed setup, project bootstrap, Project Lead commission, Workstream launch, spawned execution, fresh assurance, and learning routing for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap projects and launch verified Workstreams.
interface.longDescription: Codex Kit manages machine setup, bootstraps durable project guidance, commissions project-aware Project Leads, launches branch-based Workstream tasks in saved projects, requires spawned execution and fresh assurance, and routes accepted learnings to the correct source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-kit:setup to preview and validate machine setup.
Use $codex-kit:bootstrap to inspect and intake this project.
Use $codex-kit:commission to create and pin one Project Lead.
Use $codex-kit:launch inside Project Lead - <Project> to start work.
